# Commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/reference.py from the command line. Do not edit: run `just reference`. -->

Every command accepts `--config PATH` (or `LOOKOUT_CONFIG`) before its name to choose the
configuration file, and `--help`.

## `lookout act`

Open, finish, dismiss, snooze or star an item.

| Argument | |
| --- | --- |
| `item_id` | Item id, as shown by `inbox`. |
| `action` |  One of: `open`, `done`, `dismiss`, `snooze`, `reopen`, `star`, `unstar`. |

| Option | |
| --- | --- |
| `--hours` | Snooze duration. Default: `24.0`. |
| `--until` | Snooze until an ISO date and time. |

## `lookout demo`

Add demo items to try the dashboard.

## `lookout doctor`

Check the database, the model endpoint and every source.

## `lookout explain`

Say why an item has its priority and its place in the inbox.

| Argument | |
| --- | --- |
| `item_id` | Item id. |

## `lookout export`

Print every item as JSON lines.

## `lookout forget`

Reset what Lookout learnt from your actions; items stay.

## `lookout inbox`

List items, most urgent first.

| Option | |
| --- | --- |
| `--priority`, `-p` | P0 to P3, repeatable. |
| `--category` |  |
| `--source` |  |
| `--state` | Default: new and seen. One of: `new`, `seen`, `done`, `snoozed`, `dismissed`. |
| `--starred` | Only starred items. |
| `--text` |  |
| `--limit` |  Default: `30`. |

## `lookout reassess`

Recompute priorities after changing the stack or the thresholds (no model call).

## `lookout run`

Fetch every source, then have the model read the new items.

## `lookout serve`

Serve the API and the dashboard, and run on the configured schedule.

| Option | |
| --- | --- |
| `--host` | Address to listen on. Default: `127.0.0.1`. |
| `--port` |  Default: `8899`. |

## `lookout version`

Print the installed version.
